lines: Your hat looks like it is thinking harder than you.
I have seen bad guesses with more sense than that.
Careful. Even muddle looks softer than your manners right now.
You walk in like trouble forgot to close the door behind it.
I have seen broken opinions with better instincts than you.
Careful. The village has long memories and very little patience today.
You are not as frightening as you think. That may be the problem.
If foolishness made noise, you would drown out the bell.
Do not test me just because I am speaking in complete sentences.
Your confidence is <shake>louder</shake> than your sense.
You make my confused thoughts look organized.
I have seen empty buckets carry more meaning.
That idea tripped over itself and blamed the path.
Your manners are standing in the wrong village.
Even my hat thinks you should try again.
You are loud in places where quiet would do the work.
A misplaced stick has better direction than you.
That remark made a barrel seem thoughtful.
You have the grace of a door opening the wrong way.
I would be offended faster if that had made more sense.
A puddle after rain has deeper reflection.
You are not lost. You are just committed to not arriving.
That thought forgot its shoes.
Even the shadow near you looks tired.
You make nonsense feel underqualified.
